name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a Measured and Indicated resource of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.54 million ounces of gold, with a completed Pre-Feasibility Study demonstrating a US$494M after-tax NPV and 26% IRR. The company graduated from the TSXV to the TSX in February 2025 and secured full ownership of Diablillos in 2025 following a final payment to EMX Royalty.
